chunks.title: BNP Paribas (BNP Paribas) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: BNP Paribas is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in France. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Major international banking delegation at COP31 Antalya (22 accredited delegates) engaging in corporate transition & green bond dialogues. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Global low-carbon energy transition financing, green bond structuring, and corporate sustainability-linked lending active at COP31. Source verification: https://thefederal.com/the-federal-special/cop31-in-antalya-big-polluters-and-climate-activists-under-one-roof-262803.

chunks.title: BNP Paribas Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: BNP Paribas provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Bond Structuring, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Renewable Project Finance, Green Trade Finance, Transition Advisory. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 20,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Sovereign/Government.

chunks.title: BNP Paribas Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by BNP Paribas: Renewable Energy, Electrification & Grid, Industrial Decarbonization, Clean Transport, Green Buildings, Energy Storage. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, EMEA, Türkiye, Americas, Asia-Pacific. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: BNP Paribas Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete BNP Paribas's application form: ICMA Green Bond Principles / LMA GLP or SLLP compliance; Credible corporate net-zero transition plan & Scope 1/2/3 baselines; Second-Party Opinion (SPO) & external KPI assurance; Investment-grade or bankable project finance cash flows. Explicit exclusion rules: New oil & gas field financing; Thermal coal mining/power. Official application portal: https://cib.bnpparibas/sustainable-finance/.

chunks.title: BNP Paribas Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: BNP Paribas uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
